description: DUT accepts a TCP packet with valid header fields and ACKs with the expected ack_num (RFC 793 §3.9)
approach:
[Objective]
The positive baseline for header acceptance: a well-formed segment with payload must be acked correctly. Anchors HEADER_07/08/09 negative cases.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake.
2. Tester → DUT: well-formed data segment.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: ACK with ack_num covering payload.

[Pass condition]
DUT acks the data with correct ack_num.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack — handshake never completed
• Fail_no_data_ack — DUT did not ack data
• Fail_wrong_ack_num — ACK does not cover payload

verdicts.Pass: DUT acked valid data with correct ack_num — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_data_ack: No DUT ACK to valid data
verdicts.Fail_wrong_ack_num: DUT ack_num does not acknowledge payload
